tasks.title: Project skeleton
tasks.desc: index.html, style.css and app.js, loaded without a build step.

tasks.title: Recipe data file
tasks.desc: `recipes.json` with 6 recipes: name, tags (vegetarian, quick, dessert), ingredients as text, steps.

tasks.title: Load and list recipes
tasks.desc: Fetch recipes.json and render one card per recipe: name and tags.

tasks.title: Recipe detail view
tasks.desc: Clicking a card shows its ingredients and steps; a back link returns to the list.

tasks.title: Search box
tasks.desc: Filter the list by name or ingredient as the user types.

tasks.title: Tag filter chips
tasks.desc: Chips for vegetarian, quick and dessert; several can be on at once.

tasks.title: Dark mode
tasks.desc: Follow prefers-color-scheme.

tasks.title: Favourites
tasks.desc: A star on each recipe; favourites are kept in localStorage and can be listed alone.

tasks.title: Structured ingredient quantities
tasks.desc: Each ingredient in recipes.json becomes {amount, unit, item} instead of text, so amounts can be computed.

tasks.title: Serving size scaler
tasks.desc: Round amounts to two decimals.

tasks.title: Print-friendly recipe
tasks.desc: A print stylesheet: only the open recipe, no header or controls.

tasks.title: Shopping list
tasks.desc: Sort the list by item name.

tasks.title: Smoke check script
tasks.desc: `check.sh`: node --check on every script, and recipes.json parses and has the fields the app reads.

tasks.title: Share recipe with a friend
tasks.desc: Copy the open recipe as plain text (title, ingredients, steps) so it can be pasted into a message or email. Adds a Share button to the recipe detail view.

tasks.title: Export recipes as JSON file
tasks.desc: Let the user download the whole recipe collection as a single JSON file for backup or moving to another device. Builds on the recipe loading module.

tasks.title: Import recipes from JSON file
tasks.desc: Load a previously exported JSON file back into the app, merging or replacing the current collection after user confirmation. Depends on the export format from SH-02.

tasks.title: Use the app offline
tasks.desc: Verify and document that the whole recipe book works with no network when opened from disk or a local server, and fix anything that assumes connectivity. No service worker or external assets; everything stays local.

tasks.title: Accessibility pass
tasks.desc: Keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, focus visibility and contrast checks across list, detail, search and filter views. Includes testing with a screen reader.

tasks.title: Automated test script
tasks.desc: Plain script that checks core flows without network or dependencies: recipe loading, search, share text output, and export file content. Extends the smoke check approach.

tasks.title: Cache the app for offline use
tasks.desc: Add a web app manifest and service worker that cache the app shell and recipe data after the first visit. Let users reopen and browse the recipe book without a network connection.

tasks.title: Share shopping list as text
tasks.desc: Copy the generated shopping list as plain text so it can be sent to anyone or pasted into another app. Adds a copy button to the shopping list view.

tasks.title: Show offline readiness and status
tasks.desc: Show whether the app is ready for offline use and whether the browser is currently offline. Provide a clear retry action if caching fails.

tasks.title: Add automated recipe behavior tests
tasks.desc: Add a dependency-free browser test page that automatically checks recipe loading, search, tag filtering, favourites, and serving-size calculations. Report each result clearly as pass or fail.

tasks.title: Test sharing, accessibility, and offline use
tasks.desc: Extend the local automated tests to verify shared text, JSON export contents, keyboard accessibility, and offline reload behavior. Document one local command or page that runs all checks without external services.

tasks.title: Export recipes as JSON
tasks.desc: A button downloads every recipe as one JSON file, in the same shape as recipes.json.
